title: englerophytum longepedicellatum
intro: Englerophytum longepedicellatum, commonly known as African Long Peduncle, is a plant species belonging to the family Sapotaceae. It has been traditionally used in West African folk medicine, offering potential health benefits such as wound healing, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Englerophytum longepedicellatum include analgesic, anti-edematous, and antiseptic effects, which contribute to its wound healing and anti-inflammatory activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
